scope: Prototype terminal, hardware dimensions and rejected catalogue candidates. No purchasing, supplier acceptance or physical result.

sources.drawing: Keystone 4004, revision A, 2009-06-25; actual drawing inspected locally
sources.decision: Not selected. The ring is smaller than the 7.34mm collar bore and cannot supply circular rear bearing. A longer tongue alone does not establish qualified retention.
Candidate load-spreading washer between nut and custom terminal, not the part that bridges the collar bore. OD <=6.1mm is an additional incoming requirement.
Existing nut candidate retained. Dimensional fit does not qualify torque, resistance or loosening. Hidden stock-status HTML is not availability evidence.

sources.inspected: Manufacturer material table parsed by web tool; no local visual drawing claim
sources.decision: Basis for a candidate material callout only. Actual 1mm stock, temper certificate, machining/plating and joint strength require fabricator acceptance; no stress or torque qualification is inferred.

sources.inspected: TE-authored product specification, 2022-12-07, parsed by web tool
sources.decision: Not selected. Specified 1.02 to 1.52mm insulation support range does not cover Alpha 2843/7's 0.8382mm maximum diameter. The page also lists inconsistent M3/2.54mm stud data; no drawing-based fit approval was made.
